implementation_note: A fast order-statistics implementation was parity-checked against src.signals.risk_engine.past_percentile_rank on 600-row samples for seven ranked series before full-panel execution.
method: Full-panel counterfactual comparison: source-published residual load versus residual load recomputed from total load minus wind onshore, solar and wind offshore.
ranking_semantics: At each timestamp, percentile equals the share of non-null historical values strictly before that timestamp that are less than or equal to the current value.
